name: zc_avatar_memory

tests.name: the engine reports its own memory
the two passes of each mode agree well enough to compare the modes

detail.note: the same setting measured early and late. If these disagree by more than the gap between SETTINGS, this measured the machine rather than the quadtree.

tests.name: the quadtree is or is not most of an avatar's footprint

detail.note: reported either way. A large positive gap means a crowd gets dramatically cheaper for one console variable and P0 item 5 stops being art-bound; a small one means the footprint is the instances themselves and only the art can move it.
